resources.string: Select a declared input domain and transform type explicitly; names do not determine either. Only 3D .cube files, 2–33 points per axis, up to 2 MiB each; 8 entries / 16 MiB total.

Operator and subject selections affect only their independent GPU previews. The separate recording selection below can permanently change video pixels. Scopes remain pre-LUT. Output uses SDR codes, not HDR or ACES. All selections are local and excluded from camera presets.
Remove this LUT? Operator, subject and recording selections using it will be disabled. Other selections and already saved media are unchanged.
Replace the retained library with an empty one? This removes its LUT originals and all three local selections. Export backups before resetting when available.
Library unavailable or corrupt. Retained bytes have not been cleared. New LUT activation is unavailable until reopening or explicit reset. An ongoing recording keeps its frozen file intent.
The operation failed. Check the declared metadata, file format, limits and storage. No successful import or export is claimed.
Input domain minimum: %1$s; maximum: %2$s. Output: SDR BT.709 codes.
Operator application: waiting for a compatible GPU preview
Operator application: selected LUT input does not match this signal domain
Operator application: failed; selected does not mean applied

Subject selection is independent: it never inherits the operator LUT. It applies only to a compatible live GPU subject preview in VIDEO or LOG, not idle displays. Selected does not mean currently applied.
Subject application: waiting for a compatible live preview
Subject application: selected LUT input does not match this signal domain
Subject application: failed; selection remains separate from application

File LUT is an independent, explicit choice for subsequent video recordings. It irreversibly changes encoded pixels, unlike preview LUTs. Selecting a monitor LUT never enables it. Existing takes keep their admitted intent; selecting does not prove native application.
Recording selection (local, applies to subsequent takes)
Disable file LUT for subsequent takes

Confirm permanent pixel changes? This LUT will be baked into subsequent compatible video recordings until disabled. Its effect cannot be removed from those files afterward. It is independent of operator and subject previews; photos are unchanged.
File LUT evidence: waiting for native application
File LUT evidence: incompatible input domain
File LUT evidence: natively applied to recorded pixels
File LUT evidence: failed; selection is not proof of application
A library change is pending for a subsequent take. The current file keeps its frozen LUT intent.
File LUT controls are locked during capture, recording preparation and finalization. Monitor selections remain editable.
The LUT library is not ready or is unavailable. Review or explicitly reset the library in settings before recording; its persisted file selection will not be silently skipped.
The file LUT input does not match the signal domain of this mode. Choose a compatible file LUT or explicitly disable it before recording.
